name: blocky3d
description: Build tooling for the blocky3D runtime bundle, the standalone demos and the IDE's offline files. The IDE itself runs as plain files.

scripts.build: esbuild tools/runtime-entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=inline --outfile=runtime/blocky3d.runtime.js && node --no-warnings tools/build-demo.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/build-ide.mjs
